name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Precision-preserving text-only recipe for Inferact's ModelOpt NVFP4 Qwen3.8 checkpoint on one NVIDIA GB10.

performance.note: The complete pinned publisher-NVFP4 checkpoint passed a 64-token GB10 performance probe. Exact 64K context, capability, quality, and 60-minute endurance gates remain outstanding.

limitations: Beta 0.1 FTW preparation preserves Inferact's native ModelOpt NVFP4 routed experts without conversion-time requantization; all served non-expert tensors retain their published precision.
The published BF16 n-gram table is extracted into an approximately 102.4 GB random-read artifact during preparation.
The complete pinned checkpoint and 180,433,108,992-byte FTW artifact were validated; the measured 12.584 tok/s and 0.786 s warm TTFT pass the Frontier performance thresholds.
GB10-QWEN38-FRONTIER-001 and GB10-QWEN38-FP8-001 describe superseded recipe/checkpoint tuples and do not transfer to this 0.5.0 release.
QSA selection currently runs eagerly, so CUDA graph capture is disabled.
The published checkpoint is multimodal; initial Spark Lab certification is text-only.
Exact 64K recall, capability, quality, and endurance gates have not yet been run on the Inferact NVFP4 artifact.
The performance host had 2.71 GiB of unrelated swap resident before launch, although the measured request swapped no pages out.
